Coverage_Description: Child-focused savings life plan with lifelong coverage; one-off guaranteed withdrawable cash of 105% of notional amount at policy year 18; death benefit at least 180% of notional amount ("挚爱宝" pays 20% of death benefit if death occurs within 180 days after birth)
pricing: US$30,000/year for 5 years (illustrative; total US$150,000, notional amount US$150,000).
customer requirement: Policy owner with insurable interest (parent/grandparent/legal guardian; or expectant parent for prenatal option)
additional informations: Academic Excellence Award up to US$5,000; premium waiver on policyholder/spouse death (cap US$125,000); successor policyholder and policy trustee options
